sections.title: Established & Tested
sections.sub: Verified, landed, and running in daily production use.

features.title: Chat Bubble & Request ID Copy Controls
features.desc: Click any user or bot message bubble to instantly copy its text.  Hover for a dedicated copy button with right-click options to copy the Request ID or Message ID for quick logging.

features.title: Usage Telemetry & Central Accounting
features.desc: Live token consumption (prompt, completion, cache hits) and model costs stream to Usage Monitor (usage.jays.services) with automatic project and repo classification.

features.title: Multi-Repo Channels & Interactive File Links
features.desc: Channels can attach multiple repositories (e.g. AI Fleet Coordinator + Fleet Ops) with automatic context injection.  Local file links open in default Mac apps with 1 click or reveal in Finder on Option-click.

features.title: Native DeepSeek Engine & Pricing Breakdown
features.desc: Native API and ACP drivers for DeepSeek V4 Flash, V4 Pro, and R1 Reasoner, complete with an in-app model rates and token pricing reference in Settings.

features.title: Multi-Tier Model Fallback Chains
features.desc: Assign 1st, 2nd, and 3rd choice fallback models to each bot.  When primary engines hit rate limits or downtime, BotFleet degrades down the chain automatically without interrupting work.

features.title: Mid-Task Crash & Restart Recovery
features.desc: Interrupted turns and mid-flight tool executions are automatically detected on boot, prompting immediate resumption instead of leaving tasks stuck in an unknown state.

features.title: Dynamic System Theme & Update Controls
features.desc: Theme auto-switches between dark and light to match macOS.  Includes update toggle preferences and refined in-app banner controls.

features.title: Custom BotFleet Brand & Icons
features.desc: Custom metallic robot trio mascot branding and matching full-bleed macOS and iOS app icon sets across the entire fleet ecosystem.

sections.title: Beta & In Review
sections.sub: Feature-complete add-ons undergoing active tuning and review.

features.title: Always-On iMessage Relay Daemon
features.desc: Background relay daemon connecting Messages.app bot group chats to the BotFleet backend with persistent launchd supervision.

features.title: iOS Companion Deep-Link Infrastructure
features.desc: Universal Links (BotFleet.app), App Groups, and Remote Control companion for iPhone and iPad, prepared for public TestFlight.

features.title: Fleet MCP Tools & Standard Skills
features.desc: Global MCP servers from Claude desktop configurations merged into BotFleet agents, alongside standard fleet repo skills.

features.title: Custom Webhook Ingress Domain
features.desc: Route webhook triggers to a dedicated custom domain with token validation for external CI/CD pipelines.

features.title: One-Command TestFlight Ship
features.desc: Automated signing, archiving, and TestFlight upload pipeline from the Mac build environment.
